# Lots

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List lots

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/lots`

Retrieve a paginated list of lots with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: product, uom, location, company, creator, quantities | `product,location` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by lot name | `LOT` |
| `filter[product_id]` | string | No | Filter by product IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[reference]` | string | No | Filter by reference | `BATCH` |
| `filter[location_id]` | string | No | Filter by location IDs | `architecto` |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Filter by company IDs | `architecto` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/lots?include=product%2Clocation&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=LOT&filter%5Bproduct_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Breference%5D=BATCH&filter%5Blocation_id%5D=architecto&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

## Create lot

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/lots`

Create a new lot

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Lot/serial number. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `product_id` | integer | Yes | Tracked product ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `reference` | string | No | Internal lot reference. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `description` | string | No | Lot description. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/lots" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "LOT-2026-001",
  "product_id": 1,
  "reference": "BATCH-A1",
  "description": "Primary production batch."
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/lots", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "LOT-2026-001",
  "product_id": 1,
  "reference": "BATCH-A1",
  "description": "Primary production batch."
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/lots', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'name' => 'LOT-2026-001',
    'product_id' => 1,
    'reference' => 'BATCH-A1',
    'description' => 'Primary production batch.',
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/lots"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "name": "LOT-2026-001",
    "product_id": 1,
    "reference": "BATCH-A1",
    "description": "Primary production batch.",
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

:::

**Example response** <Badge type="info" text="201" />
